subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental auth artifacts for procurement review
messages:
From: procurement@hearthhealth.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental auth artifacts for procurement review

Hi Aisha,

We're kicking off our security procurement review for Redwood as part of our upcoming contract renewal. Can you share your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering at least 2026) and the following supplemental artifacts to validate authentication and access controls?

- MFA enforcement evidence (policy + sample access logs showing MFA challenge results) for the period 2026-11-01 to 2027-04-30
- Evidence of periodic access reviews (samples of reviewer notes / completed reviews)
- Service account rotation records and any exception approvals
- A draft bridge letter if the report period doesn't fully cover our desired audit window

We need these materials by end of week to keep our procurement timeline. If you have a shared Drive folder or a procurement contact to coordinate with, please advise.

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Procurement Manager
HearthHealth
procurement@hearthhealth.com

--
Note: Please send attachments as PDFs or CSV extracts where possible.
From: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
To: procurement@hearthhealth.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental auth artifacts for procurement review

Priya —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Security (Vivek), Compliance (Lauren), and Engineering (Marcus) to pull the exact artifacts.

Quick clarifications so we provide precisely what you need:
- Confirming audit window: you asked 2026-11-01 through 2027-04-30 — is that the full scope you require for MFA log slices?
- For access reviews: do you need full reviewer notes or redacted samples (we can provide redacted reviewer logs for privacy)?
- Service account rotation: do you want rotation evidence for system accounts only, or CI/CD/service credentials as well?

If you confirm those items this morning we will target a delivery plan by EOD Thursday.

Aisha Rahman
Head of Sales Ops (contract/procurement liaison)
Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com, procurement@hearthhealth.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental auth artifacts for procurement review

Hi all —

Thanks, Aisha / Priya. We can provide the requested artifacts. Outline below is what we can deliver and proposed redaction rules to preserve customer privacy.

Deliverables (what we will attach/provide):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — our latest period ending 2026-12-31.
2) MFA policy (PDF) and MFA rotation/exception addendum (PDF).
3) Auth log slice (CSV) covering 2026-11-01 -> 2027-04-30 — includes timestamp, user_id (hashed), event_type (login, token_issue), mfa_challenge_result (success/fail), auth_method (TOTP/webauthn/sso). We'll redact identifiable user emails and replace with hashed identifiers per your privacy note.
4) Access review samples (PDF/CSV) — redacted reviewer names, include review dates, scope, action taken (remove/role-change/none).
5) Service account rotation evidence — rotation schedule (PDF) and rotation audit trail (CSV) for system/service accounts; we will include exception approvals where rotation has been deferred, with redacted approver names.
6) Draft bridge letter (DOCX) that explains the audit window coverage and our ability to provide slices of logs outside the SOC period.

Timeline: We will prepare documents 1-5 by end of day Thursday (2027-05-13) and share via a secure Drive folder. Draft bridge letter by Friday (2027-05-14) for your review. If you need earlier access to any individual artifact, tell us which and we'll prioritize.

Technical notes / limitations:
- Auth log slices will be provided as CSV extracts; they will not include full request/response payloads.
- For MFA challenge details, we can provide outcome (success/fail) and challenge type but not device identifiers.
- Access review exports are limited to reviewer comments and actions; internal HR notes will be omitted.

If Bright Audit needs a different format (Syslog, JSON), please indicate.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will attach) soc2-type2-2026.pdf, mfa-rotation-policy.pdf, authz-log-slice-20261101-20270430.csv, bridge-letter-draft.docx
From: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
To: procurement@hearthhealth.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental auth artifacts for procurement review

Hi Priya —

Thanks for confirming. Attached are the artifacts we discussed: soc2-type2-2026.pdf, mfa-rotation-policy.pdf, and a redacted auth log slice covering 2026-11-01 through 2027-04-30. Also sharing a draft bridge letter to cover any gaps between the SOC report period and your desired window.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Redwood-HearthHealth-evidence
HubSpot reference: HS-Record-123456

Next steps we propose:
- Please confirm the redaction level on the auth log slice is acceptable (we hashed user IDs and removed emails).
- If Bright Audit needs additional columns (e.g., IPs or device IDs) please let us know and we'll evaluate privacy constraints and provide a secure export if approved.
- Once you confirm acceptance of the artifacts, we can finalize the bridge letter and produce any requested supplementary exports (requires approvals and may take 3 business days).

Happy to set a 30-minute call with our security team if Bright Audit would like to walk through the artifacts. Proposed slot: Thu 2027-05-13 11:00 PT.

Best regards,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
